nodes.name: Felix drafts survey map
nodes.description: Felix Adler works meticulously over a large survey map, adding details in deep blue ink.
evidence: FELIX ADLER (40s, meticulous, ink-stained fingers) leans over the largest table, adding detail to an enormous survey map.
The lines are drawn in DEEP BLUE INK -- rivers, roads, mountain ridges, all rendered in the same rich blue.

nodes.name: Felix twists silver ring
nodes.description: Felix pauses his work and absently twists the silver ring on his right hand, revealing a habitual gesture.
evidence: He pauses, sets down his quill, and absently twists the SILVER RING on his RIGHT HAND -- a habit.

nodes.name: Sable enters with parchments
nodes.description: Sable Cross enters the workshop carrying a bundle of reference parchments.
evidence: SABLE CROSS (20s, Felix's apprentice) enters from a side door, her LONG RED HAIR loosely braided over one shoulder. She carries a bundle of reference parchments.

nodes.name: Sable delivers elevation surveys
nodes.description: Sable presents the elevation surveys from the northern pass that Felix had requested.
evidence:
SABLE
The elevation surveys from the northern pass. As requested.

nodes.name: Felix directs placement of surveys
nodes.description: Without looking up, Felix instructs Sable to place the surveys to his left because he needs the ridge-line cross-reference.
evidence:
FELIX
(without looking up)
Set them to the left. I need the ridge-line cross-reference.

nodes.name: Sable studies and praises map
nodes.description: After setting down the parchments, Sable examines Felix's map and calls it beautiful.
evidence:
SABLE
It is beautiful.
Sable sets the bundle down and studies the map.

nodes.name: Felix rejects praise as premature
nodes.description: Felix dismisses Sable's compliment, insisting the map is incomplete and telling her to return only when it is finished.
evidence:
FELIX
It is incomplete. Come back when it is finished.

nodes.name: Felix resumes mapping in blue ink
aliases: Felix resumes mapping in blue ink
nodes.description: Felix uncaps a fresh quill, dips it in blue ink, and continues extending the survey lines across the Northern Reaches map.
evidence: The deep blue lines extend across the parchment of the Northern Reaches survey.
He uncaps a fresh quill and dips it in the BLUE INK.
